releases.name: Infernape vs Gallade SP Deck Kit (Infernape)

description.text: The Infernape deck of Infernape VS Gallade, the first of two Versus Starter Packs SP, released on 26 December 2008 with the Bonds to the End of Time expansion. Its theme is the Elite Four of the Pokémon League: every Pokémon in it is an SP Pokémon marked with the Elite Four's 四 symbol, with Flint's and Bertha's Pokémon in the Infernape deck and Aaron's and Lucian's in the Gallade deck, each with that member's own Trainer card. Its two ready-built 30-card half decks hold four holo cards, Infernape E4 LV.X and Gallade E4 LV.X among them, and came with damage counters and markers, a coin and a how-to-play book.
